goal: Move Prometeo from manually numbered delegated workers to a durable self-assigning multi-project swarm with one generic worker bootstrap, atomic claims, continuous planning, post-return continuation and dot-only parent operation.
precondition: B-BIGPIC-01 substantially terminal and parent/steward convergence produces Architecture/Active Method vNext. Plan may be refined by that convergence but must preserve the human-friction/autonomous-swarm objective.

phases.title: Convergence and canonical next architecture
phases.gate: All material B-BIGPIC-01 returns consumed or explicitly bounded/stale; contradiction/overlap matrix complete; Big Picture + Survival Set coverage audit complete.

phases.title: Autonomous swarm kernel

parallel_work.mission: Implement canonical Opportunity Queue schema + derived ready/blocked states.
Implement create-if-absent atomic claim/pin + lease/stale/retry/supersession semantics.
Implement and publish generic fresh worker bootstrap `/w` that self-selects a compatible READY opportunity.
Implement global CONTINUITY_HEAD.json compiler/projection for successors, workers and Live.
Implement Planner/queue compiler consuming goals, returns, incidents, proposals and dependencies.
Implement POST_RETURN scan: safely claim more work, verify, propose follow-ups or become idle.
Implement isolated append-only worker proposal format and promotion/dedup flow.
Implement append-only progress events and derived telemetry buckets without fake percent complete.

phases.integration_gate: Generic queue/claim/bootstrap cannot be declared operational until collision tests and stale-recovery tests pass.

phases.title: Multi-root expansion

parallel_work.mission: Archaeology/discovery of Facultad durable state; bind a primary Chat Object/campaign controller without asking human to ferry prior chat context.
Archaeology/discovery of Alumnos durable state; bind primary Chat Object and reconcile student-world/pagekit/jose-study workstreams.
Implement global opportunity selection across project roots while preserving project-specific authority/privacy.

phases.gate: At least Prometeo + Facultad + Alumnos appear as recoverable durable roots with independent FOCUS/campaign state.

phases.title: Identical-worker swarm canary
phases.test: Open multiple fresh chats with exactly the same `/w` bootstrap. Each must independently claim a different READY opportunity or safely report no compatible work; no duplicate substantive execution from claim races.
required_tests: worker POST_RETURN picks second safe task only when allowed

phases.title: Self-propagating campaign loop
phases.test: A real campaign generates first wave -> returns -> proposals/incidents -> steward integration -> planner-generated second wave without human redesigning prompts or transporting results.
phases.gate: At least two worker generations complete with only thread-opening as unavoidable platform boundary.

phases.title: Parent erasure test
phases.test: Delete/abandon parent conversation while multiple project roots and a campaign are active. Fresh parent reincarnates from stable entry/Continuity Head and continues correctly.
phases.gate: Human does not need to remember plan, active workers, returned results or next wave.

phases.title: Minimal ambient Live projection
phases.mission: Replace verbose Live default with black ambient screen: activity light + working/done/waiting/problem counts + short current action + real event timeline; put all diagnostics/recovery commands behind one toggle.
phases.law: Live remains read-only projection and never becomes correctness dependency.

next_dot_rule: On next `.` refresh B-BIGPIC-01. If remaining scouts are terminal, immediately start convergence. If some are still legitimately working, consume all available returns and prepare the convergence matrix while waiting; do not idle and do not divert to Live cosmetics.
